SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana,
    AVG(e.ANA) / (
        SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM (
            SELECT AVG(e2.ANA) as avg_ana
            FROM Patient p2
            INNER JOIN Examination e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID
            WHERE p2.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
            GROUP BY p2.SEX
        )
    ) as ana_ratio
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX
